rationale: D did not achieve90% generation in any language and remaining errors mostly name the wrong color/object. Compare P-only perceptual memory: new common-L2-normalized CNN24cell baselineF0 versus PNG-derived unordered2component continuous descriptors repeated12timesF1. Same globalCNN, U, P structure/initial weights/capacity, fit/dev boundary, native stream, seed and budget; final U must stay identical. This is an ENGINEERED ideal-perception diagnostic using a uniform background and exactly two separate flat objects, not learned general/human vision or a single internal feature ablation. No Scene, palette/class/role IDs, filenames or fitted dev/protected statistics. Mixed policy is an explicitly fixed working hypothesis, NOT an accepted winner of invalid E; corrected E2 runs independently in parallel.

selection_rule.full_candidate: Require every language in ONE condition at fixed9600 to meet all original U/P/four diagnostic score+coverage criteria. If both conditions meet all, prefer F0; no intermediate peaks or spliced metrics.
selection_rule.producer_for_next_U_test: If full L1 criteria still fail, prefer a condition whose final P is >=.9 in all four languages; if both, F0. If neither, maximize the minimum final P across four languages; exact tie F0. This is a developmental engineering rule, not significance or qualification.
selection_rule.failure_policy: No anchor removal, score relaxation, retries or silent fallback; keep invalid original E and every F failure.
